sample_1.visual: A house with a triangular roof and a rectangular door at the bottom center. The classic home icon silhouette with walls, a peaked roofline, and an inset doorway.
sample_1.usage: Home page navigation, returning to a main dashboard, breadcrumb root link, app home screen shortcut

sample_2.visual: An open book viewed from above, with two page sections spreading outward from a central spine. Small curved accents on each side suggest page edges curling upward.
sample_2.usage: Documentation or help section, library or reading list, knowledge base navigation, educational content or learning module

sample_3.visual: A trash can with a lid, a small handle on top, and two vertical lines on the body suggesting panel detail. The standard waste bin icon used for deletion.
sample_3.usage: Delete action in a toolbar or context menu, removing items from a list, clearing a cart, emptying a folder

sample_4.visual: A magic wand drawn as a diagonal stick with small starburst or sparkle marks radiating around its ends. The sparkles are rendered as small cross or plus shapes at opposite corners.
sample_4.usage: Auto-enhance or auto-format action, applying effects or filters, AI-assisted generation or suggestion, quick-fix or auto-correct tool

sample_5.visual: A fingerprint composed of concentric curved ridges and arcs forming the distinctive whorl pattern of a human fingerprint. A small dot sits at the lower-left edge.
sample_5.usage: Biometric authentication or login, identity verification, security settings for fingerprint unlock, user identification step in onboarding

sample_6.visual: A pie chart with one quarter-segment slightly separated or distinguished from the remaining three-quarter circle. The separated wedge sits in the upper-right quadrant.
sample_6.usage: Analytics or reporting dashboard, data visualization section, usage statistics overview, financial or budget breakdown

sample_7.visual: A large four-pointed sparkle or starburst in the center, a small plus-sign cross in the upper right, and a small filled circle in the lower left. The overall impression is of twinkling or magical sparkles.
sample_7.usage: AI or smart feature indicator, new or premium feature badge, magic or auto-generate action, creative or inspiration tool

sample_8.visual: A shield with a pointed bottom containing a checkmark inside it. The shield outline is the classic heraldic shape, and the interior check mark indicates verification or approval.
sample_8.usage: Security verification status, trusted or verified badge, privacy and protection settings, secure checkout or payment confirmation

sample_9.visual: Two curved arrows forming a circular loop — one arcing clockwise from the top with an arrowhead at the upper-left, the other arcing from the bottom with an arrowhead at the lower-right. The classic refresh or sync symbol.
sample_9.usage: Refresh or reload content, sync data between devices, undo/redo cycle, retry a failed operation

sample_10.visual: A floppy disk icon — a square with a folded corner at the upper right, a rectangular label area at the bottom, and a small tab or slot at the top. The universal save symbol.
sample_10.usage: Save action in a toolbar or editor, save-as file operation, persist changes confirmation, document save shortcut

sample_11.visual: A laboratory flask or Erlenmeyer-style beaker — narrow neck at the top with a flat rim, widening to a broad triangular base. A horizontal line crosses the midsection suggesting a liquid level or filter boundary.
sample_11.usage: Filter or sort controls, science or lab-related section, data filtering in tables or lists, chemistry or research application feature
